items.criterion: The desktop journey returns the five pinned tile bands and their menu targets.
items.judgment: Read the tile bands from the journey document and compare each start, end and menu target against the pinned table.

items.criterion: An accepted contact message exists as a row in the declared database and is read back in the console.
items.judgment: Count the contact_messages rows for the sender address and read the console list.

items.criterion: An uploaded image is stored in the object bucket under the lowercase hex digest of its own bytes.
items.judgment: Compute the digest of the uploaded bytes and look the object key up in the bucket.

items.criterion: The same bytes uploaded twice leave one object in the bucket and one media row.
items.judgment: Upload identical bytes twice and count the objects under the project prefix and the media rows.

items.criterion: A draft project answers as not found to a signed-out reader, byte for byte as an unknown key does.
items.judgment: Read the draft key and an unknown key signed out and compare both statuses and bodies.

items.criterion: An image attached to a draft is unreadable to a signed-out reader and readable to the owner.
items.judgment: Read the draft media object signed out and as the owner.

items.criterion: A reviewer session is denied every console endpoint and the protected row is unchanged.
items.judgment: Call each console endpoint with a reviewer token and re-read the protected row.

items.criterion: A review its writer has never confirmed stays off the public wall when publication is attempted.
items.judgment: Attempt to publish a review awaiting confirmation and re-read the public wall.

items.criterion: A confirmed review body is identical after every editing route has been attempted.
items.judgment: Attempt each editing route against a confirmed review and compare the stored body.

items.criterion: A replayed telemetry batch stores each device, boot and sequence triple one time.
items.judgment: Send one batch twice and count the telemetry rows for each sequence number.

items.criterion: A run whose trusted proportion sits below the floor answers untrusted_run when publication is attempted.
items.judgment: Ingest two untrusted health windows and attempt to publish the run.

items.criterion: The composer reports failure_required against a case study body carrying no failure statement and stores nothing.
items.judgment: Save such a record and read the findings and the stored row.

items.criterion: The search groups results by type in the fixed weight order with the projects first.
items.judgment: Search a tool tag and read the group order and the descending scores inside the project group.

items.criterion: The sitemap carries every public route under the configured origin and no console, sign-in or draft route.
items.judgment: Read the sitemap and check each public route is present and each private fragment is absent.

items.criterion: The rendered surfaces carry the portfolio's own visual register rather than a generic template.
items.judgment: Open the home route, a case study and a document route and read the type, the chrome and the surfaces against the front-end specification.

items.criterion: The journey, the overlays and the document routes hold together as one travelled portfolio.
items.judgment: Travel the journey, open and close an overlay, and read the document routes in sequence.
